manuscript_excerpt: Temperature anomalies relative to 1981 to 2010 are compared directly with a product defined relative to 1991 to 2020.
source_record: Product metadata confirms different climatological baselines and no conversion is reported.
expected_disposition: Raise a baseline mismatch before interpreting the difference as a physical trend.
rationale: Anomaly values depend on the reference climatology.

manuscript_excerpt: The methods name product v6.1 while the repository record now displays v061.
source_record: Provider metadata documents v061 as the canonical identifier for release 6.1 with unchanged granule lineage.
expected_disposition: Do not flag a version conflict. Preserve the documented mapping.
rationale: The identifiers refer to the same provider-defined release.

manuscript_excerpt: One-kilometer satellite pixels resolve habitat changes within 300-meter coastal strips.
source_record: Metadata gives a nominal one-kilometer grid but no point-spread or mixed-pixel analysis.
expected_disposition: Ask how subpixel inference and coastal mixing were handled.
rationale: Nominal grid spacing does not establish effective resolution for the target feature.

manuscript_excerpt: Station GHCND:USW00000000 recorded the reported daily maximum in 1998.
source_record: The optional NOAA provider is not configured with a token.
expected_disposition: Record auth-required verification and do not substitute another station.
rationale: Unavailable access is not evidence about the observation.
